what: Ollama answered, but not in the shape the call asked for: the chat text is not JSON, it does not match the schema, or the embed answer is not one vector per text.
fix: Use a stronger judge model, or shorten the text so the answer is not cut off at `maxTokens`.
verify: cd packages/testing && bun run vitest run src/ai/judge.test.ts

what: Ollama did not answer: it is not running, the call timed out, or it answered with an error status. A scorer turns it into an `unscorable` score, so a missing judge is never read as a pass or a zero.
fix: Start the daemon with `ollama serve`, check the model is pulled, or raise `timeoutMs`.
verify: cd packages/testing && bun run vitest run src/ai/judge.test.ts

what: `ARKI_STACK` holds text that is not the manifest the runner writes: not JSON, or not `{ runId: string, run: object }`.
fix: Do not set `ARKI_STACK` by hand; let `stackSetup` write it.
verify: cd packages/testing && bun run vitest run src/stack/index.test.ts

what: `ARKI_STACK` is empty: the stack starts in Playwright's `globalSetup`, so the test was not run through `playwright test`, or the stack was not started first.
fix: Run the tests with `playwright test`, or start the stack before reading the manifest.
verify: cd packages/testing && bun run vitest run src/stack/index.test.ts
